qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Permitted quarries, cement kilns, and aggregate deposits provide local transport-radius advantages, but heavy capital intensity and regional commodity cement pricing dynamics keep multi-cycle returns depressed.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC < 12%, REJECT). Permitted quarry and kiln transport radii create local logistics barriers, but heavy capital intensity and cyclical commodity pricing hold 10-year ROIC to 6-10% (median 10.7%), falling well short of the 12% compounder hurdle.
qualitative.evidence: Reported ROIC over the 2015-2024 decade ranged between 6.3% and 10.3%, failing to achieve the 12% threshold in any single year (5-year median 10.67%). Heavy capital intensity combined with cyclical pricing in bulk cement prevents through-cycle economic profits. The company faces multi-billion-euro decarbonization capex requirements under EU ETS rules.
